package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/service"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

const (
	practiceTaskTaskKindPart              = "practice_task_part"
	blockingReasonPartPrerequisites       = "PART_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET"
	blockingReasonParentMilestoneRequired = "PARENT_MILESTONE_NOT_PASSED"
	blockingReasonPreviousMilestone       = "PREVIOUS_MILESTONE_NOT_PASSED"
	blockingReasonStrictOrderRequired     = "STRICT_ORDER_NOT_MET"
)

type partRuntimeContext struct {
	studentPracticeTask                *domain.StudentPracticeTask
	runtimeContext                     *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext
	part                               *domain.PracticeTaskPart
	partMilestones                     []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone
	studentMilestones                  []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone
	studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone
	completedLessonIDs                 map[string]struct{}
	build                              *PartBuildPreview
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) ListStudentPracticeTaskParts(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartBundle, error) {
	project, runtimeContext, studentMilestones, completedLessons, err := useCase.loadStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeState(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID := map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{}
	for _, item := range studentMilestones {
		studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[item.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID] = item
	}

	parts := sortPracticeTaskParts(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskParts, runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones)
	items := make([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartBundle, 0, len(parts))
	for _, part := range parts {
		partMilestones := filterPartMilestones(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, part.ID)
		if len(partMilestones) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		bundle, err := useCase.buildPartBundleFromContext(&partRuntimeContext{
			studentPracticeTask:                project,
			runtimeContext:                     runtimeContext,
			part:                               &part,
			partMilestones:                     partMilestones,
			studentMilestones:                  studentMilestones,
			studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID: studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID,
			completedLessonIDs:                 completedLessons,
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		items = append(items, bundle)
	}
	return items, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetStudentPracticeTaskPart(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID, partID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartBundle, error) {
	current, err := useCase.loadPartRuntimeContext(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID, partID, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	artifacts, err := useCase.Students.ListArtifacts(ctx, current.studentPracticeTask.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	bundle, err := useCase.buildPartBundleFromContext(current, artifacts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &bundle, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) OpenPracticeTaskPart(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID, partID string) (*domain.RuntimeOpenPartResult, error) {
	current, err := useCase.loadPartRuntimeContext(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID, partID, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	bundle, err := useCase.buildPartBundleFromContext(current, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if bundle.Access.Locked {
		return nil, firstLockedPartError(bundle)
	}
	if err := useCase.setActivePracticeTaskPart(ctx, current.studentPracticeTask, partID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &domain.RuntimeOpenPartResult{
		StudentPracticeTaskID: current.studentPracticeTask.ID,
		PracticeTaskPartID:    current.part.ID,
		TaskID:                current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceTaskID,
		LessonID:              current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceLessonID,
		OpenURL:               fmt.Sprintf("/student/my-practice-tasks/%s/part/%s", current.studentPracticeTask.ID, current.part.ID),
		Access:                bundle.Access,
	}, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) ValidatePracticeTaskPart(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID, partID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartValidation, error) {
	if useCase.AnswerStarter == nil || useCase.FinalValidator == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	current, err := useCase.loadPartRuntimeContext(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID, partID, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	bundle, err := useCase.buildPartBundleFromContext(current, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if bundle.Access.Locked {
		return nil, firstLockedPartError(bundle)
	}
	if err := useCase.setActivePracticeTaskPart(ctx, current.studentPracticeTask, partID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	started, err := useCase.AnswerStarter.Handle(ctx, answeruc.StartTaskAnswerInput{
		StudentID: studentID,
		TaskID:    current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceTaskID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := useCase.FinalValidator.Handle(ctx, started.AnswerID, nil); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	validated, err := useCase.loadPartRuntimeContext(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID, partID, false)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	artifacts, err := useCase.Students.ListArtifacts(ctx, validated.studentPracticeTask.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	validatedBundle, err := useCase.buildPartBundleFromContext(validated, artifacts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := mergePartValidationResults(validatedBundle.Milestones)
	return &domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartValidation{
		Bundle: validatedBundle,
		Result: result,
	}, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) loadPartRuntimeContext(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID, studentPracticeTaskID, partID string,
	withBuild bool,
) (*partRuntimeContext, error) {
	project, runtimeContext, studentMilestones, completedLessons, err := useCase.loadStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeState(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var part *domain.PracticeTaskPart
	for index := range runtimeContext.PracticeTaskParts {
		if runtimeContext.PracticeTaskParts[index].ID != partID {
			continue
		}
		item := runtimeContext.PracticeTaskParts[index]
		part = &item
		break
	}
	if part == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	partMilestones := filterPartMilestones(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, partID)
	if len(partMilestones) == 0 {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	current := &partRuntimeContext{
		studentPracticeTask:                project,
		runtimeContext:                     runtimeContext,
		part:                               part,
		partMilestones:                     partMilestones,
		studentMilestones:                  studentMilestones,
		studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID: map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{},
		completedLessonIDs:                 completedLessons,
	}
	for _, item := range studentMilestones {
		current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[item.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID] = item
	}
	if withBuild {
		currentMilestone := currentPartMilestone(current)
		if currentMilestone == nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
		}
		build, err := useCase.Builders.BuildPartPreview(ctx, runtimeContext.PracticeTask, *part, []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{*currentMilestone})
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		current.build = build
	}
	return current, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) loadStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeState(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID, studentPracticeTaskID string,
) (*domain.StudentPracticeTask, *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, map[string]struct{}, error) {
	project, err := useCase.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, nil, err
	}
	runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(ctx, project)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, nil, err
	}
	studentMilestones, err := useCase.Students.ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, nil, err
	}
	completedLessons := map[string]struct{}{}
	lessonIDs := runtimeContextLessonIDs(runtimeContext)
	if useCase.Completion != nil && len(lessonIDs) > 0 {
		completedLessons, err = useCase.Completion.GetCompletedLessonIDs(ctx, project.StudentID, lessonIDs)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, nil, nil, err
		}
	}
	return project, runtimeContext, studentMilestones, completedLessons, nil
}

func filterPartMilestones(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, partID string) []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone {
	filtered := make([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.PracticeTaskPartID != partID {
			continue
		}
		filtered = append(filtered, item)
	}
	sort.Slice(filtered, func(left, right int) bool {
		if filtered[left].SortOrder == filtered[right].SortOrder {
			return filtered[left].Title < filtered[right].Title
		}
		return filtered[left].SortOrder < filtered[right].SortOrder
	})
	return filtered
}

func sortPracticeTaskParts(parts []domain.PracticeTaskPart, milestones []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) []domain.PracticeTaskPart {
	partOrder := map[string]int{}
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		order, ok := partOrder[milestone.PracticeTaskPartID]
		if !ok || milestone.PartSortOrder < order {
			partOrder[milestone.PracticeTaskPartID] = milestone.PartSortOrder
		}
	}
	result := append([]domain.PracticeTaskPart(nil), parts...)
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool {
		leftOrder, leftOK := partOrder[result[left].ID]
		rightOrder, rightOK := partOrder[result[right].ID]
		switch {
		case leftOK && rightOK && leftOrder != rightOrder:
			return leftOrder < rightOrder
		case leftOK != rightOK:
			return leftOK
		default:
			return result[left].Title < result[right].Title
		}
	})
	return result
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) buildPartBundleFromContext(current *partRuntimeContext, artifacts []domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact) (domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartBundle, error) {
	milestones := make([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone, 0, len(current.partMilestones))
	for _, milestone := range current.partMilestones {
		view, err := useCase.buildPartMilestoneView(current, milestone)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartBundle{}, err
		}
		milestones = append(milestones, view)
	}
	partStatus := derivePartStatus(milestones)
	access := buildPartAccess(current, milestones, partStatus)
	return domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartBundle{
		StudentPracticeTask: *current.studentPracticeTask,
		Part:                *current.part,
		Status:              partStatus,
		RuntimeTaskID:       current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceTaskID,
		RuntimeLessonID:     current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceLessonID,
		OpenURL:             fmt.Sprintf("/student/my-practice-tasks/%s/part/%s", current.studentPracticeTask.ID, current.part.ID),
		Access:              access,
		Lessons:             aggregatePartLessons(milestones, current.completedLessonIDs),
		Milestones:          milestones,
		Artifacts:           artifacts,
	}, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) buildPartMilestoneView(current *partRuntimeContext, milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) (domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone, error) {
	studentMilestone, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[milestone.ID]
	if !ok {
		return domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	prerequisites := resolvePartMilestonePrerequisites(current.runtimeContext, milestone, current.completedLessonIDs)
	status, blockingReason := resolvePartMilestoneStatus(current, milestone, studentMilestone, prerequisites)

	var validationResult *domain.ValidationRunResult
	if result, err := validationResultFromMilestone(studentMilestone); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone{}, err
	} else if validationResultHasActivity(result) {
		resultCopy := result
		validationResult = &resultCopy
	}

	return domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone{
		ID:                             milestone.ID,
		StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID: studentMilestone.ID,
		PracticeTaskMilestoneID:        milestone.PracticeTaskMilestoneID,
		PracticeTaskPartID:             milestone.PracticeTaskPartID,
		ParentPartMilestoneID:          milestone.ParentPartMilestoneID,
		MilestoneKindCode:              milestone.MilestoneKindCode,
		StackCode:                      milestone.StackCode,
		StackCodes:                     milestone.StackCodes,
		Title:                          milestone.Title,
		Description:                    milestone.Description,
		SortOrder:                      milestone.SortOrder,
		Status:                         status,
		BlockingReason:                 blockingReason,
		Prerequisites:                  prerequisites,
		LessonBindings:                 append([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding(nil), milestone.LessonBindings...),
		ValidationResult:               validationResult,
		ValidationIssues:               flattenValidationIssues(validationResult),
	}, nil
}

func resolvePartMilestonePrerequisites(
	runtimeContext *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext,
	milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone,
	completedLessons map[string]struct{},
) domain.MilestonePrerequisites {
	if len(milestone.LessonBindings) > 0 {
		return resolveExplicitLessonPrerequisites(milestone.LessonBindings, completedLessons)
	}
	requiredSkillTags := []string{}
	for _, item := range runtimeContext.MilestoneSkillTags {
		if item.MilestoneKindCode != milestone.MilestoneKindCode {
			continue
		}
		requiredSkillTags = append(requiredSkillTags, item.SkillTagCode)
	}
	requiredSkillTags = dedupeStrings(requiredSkillTags)

	matchedLessonsSet := map[string]struct{}{}
	unmatchedSkillTags := []string{}
	for _, skillTag := range requiredSkillTags {
		found := false
		for _, lessonTag := range runtimeContext.LessonSkillTags {
			if lessonTag.SkillTagCode != skillTag {
				continue
			}
			found = true
			matchedLessonsSet[lessonTag.LessonID] = struct{}{}
		}
		if !found {
			unmatchedSkillTags = append(unmatchedSkillTags, skillTag)
		}
	}

	matchedLessonIDs := sortedStringKeys(matchedLessonsSet)
	completedLessonIDs := []string{}
	for _, lessonID := range matchedLessonIDs {
		if _, ok := completedLessons[lessonID]; ok {
			completedLessonIDs = append(completedLessonIDs, lessonID)
		}
	}

	return domain.MilestonePrerequisites{
		RequiredSkillTags:  requiredSkillTags,
		MatchedLessonIDs:   matchedLessonIDs,
		CompletedLessonIDs: completedLessonIDs,
		UnmetLessonIDs:     diffStrings(matchedLessonIDs, completedLessonIDs),
		UnmatchedSkillTags: dedupeStrings(unmatchedSkillTags),
	}
}

func resolveExplicitLessonPrerequisites(bindings []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding, completedLessons map[string]struct{}) domain.MilestonePrerequisites {
	ordered := sortedRuntimeLessonBindings(bindings)
	matchedLessonIDs := make([]string, 0, len(ordered))
	recommendedLessonIDs := make([]string, 0)
	optionalLessonIDs := make([]string, 0)
	completedLessonIDs := make([]string, 0)
	unmetLessonIDs := make([]string, 0)
	alternativeGroups := make(map[string][]string)
	alternativeSatisfied := make(map[string]bool)

	for _, binding := range ordered {
		matchedLessonIDs = append(matchedLessonIDs, binding.LessonID)
		_, completed := completedLessons[binding.LessonID]
		if completed {
			completedLessonIDs = append(completedLessonIDs, binding.LessonID)
		}
		switch binding.Requirement {
		case domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRecommended:
			recommendedLessonIDs = append(recommendedLessonIDs, binding.LessonID)
		case domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementOptional:
			optionalLessonIDs = append(optionalLessonIDs, binding.LessonID)
		case domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired:
			if binding.AlternativeGroup != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*binding.AlternativeGroup) != "" {
				group := strings.TrimSpace(*binding.AlternativeGroup)
				alternativeGroups[group] = append(alternativeGroups[group], binding.LessonID)
				alternativeSatisfied[group] = alternativeSatisfied[group] || completed
			} else if !completed {
				unmetLessonIDs = append(unmetLessonIDs, binding.LessonID)
			}
		}
	}
	for group, lessonIDs := range alternativeGroups {
		if !alternativeSatisfied[group] {
			unmetLessonIDs = append(unmetLessonIDs, lessonIDs...)
		}
	}

	return domain.MilestonePrerequisites{
		MatchedLessonIDs:     dedupeStrings(matchedLessonIDs),
		RecommendedLessonIDs: dedupeStrings(recommendedLessonIDs),
		OptionalLessonIDs:    dedupeStrings(optionalLessonIDs),
		CompletedLessonIDs:   dedupeStrings(completedLessonIDs),
		UnmetLessonIDs:       dedupeStrings(unmetLessonIDs),
		RequiredSkillTags:    []string{},
		UnmatchedSkillTags:   []string{},
		UsesExplicitRoute:    true,
	}
}

func sortedRuntimeLessonBindings(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding) []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding {
	result := append([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding(nil), items...)
	sort.SliceStable(result, func(left, right int) bool {
		if result[left].SortOrder == result[right].SortOrder {
			return result[left].LessonID < result[right].LessonID
		}
		return result[left].SortOrder < result[right].SortOrder
	})
	return result
}

func resolvePartMilestoneStatus(
	current *partRuntimeContext,
	milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone,
	studentMilestone domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone,
	prerequisites domain.MilestonePrerequisites,
) (string, string) {
	if studentMilestone.Status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed {
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed, ""
	}
	if studentMilestone.Status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped {
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusSkipped, ""
	}
	if len(prerequisites.UnmetLessonIDs) > 0 || len(prerequisites.UnmatchedSkillTags) > 0 {
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked, blockingReasonMilestonePrerequisites
	}
	if parentID := parentPartMilestoneID(milestone); parentID != "" {
		parent, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[parentID]
		if !ok || !isMilestoneCompleted(parent.Status) {
			return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked, blockingReasonParentMilestoneRequired
		}
	}
	if previousID := previousRouteMilestoneID(current.runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, milestone); previousID != "" {
		previous, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[previousID]
		if !ok || !isMilestoneCompleted(previous.Status) {
			return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked, blockingReasonPreviousMilestone
		}
	}
	if current.part.IsStrictOrder {
		if previousID := previousSiblingMilestoneID(current.partMilestones, milestone); previousID != "" {
			previousMilestone, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[previousID]
			if ok && !isMilestoneCompleted(previousMilestone.Status) {
				return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked, blockingReasonStrictOrderRequired
			}
		}
	}
	switch studentMilestone.Status {
	case domain.StudentMilestoneStatusInProgress:
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusInProgress, ""
	case domain.StudentMilestoneStatusFailed:
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusFailed, ""
	default:
		if studentMilestone.TaskAnswerID != nil {
			return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusInProgress, ""
		}
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable, ""
	}
}

func buildPartAccess(current *partRuntimeContext, milestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone, status string) domain.MilestoneAccess {
	var active *domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone
	for _, item := range milestones {
		if item.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed || item.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusSkipped {
			continue
		}
		itemCopy := item
		active = &itemCopy
		break
	}

	locked := active != nil && active.Status == domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked
	blockingReason := ""
	if locked {
		blockingReason = active.BlockingReason
		if blockingReason == blockingReasonMilestonePrerequisites {
			blockingReason = blockingReasonPartPrerequisites
		}
	}
	prerequisites := domain.MilestonePrerequisites{}
	if active != nil {
		prerequisites = active.Prerequisites
	}

	return domain.MilestoneAccess{
		Status:              status,
		Locked:              locked,
		BlockingReason:      blockingReason,
		CurrentTaskID:       current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceTaskID,
		CurrentLessonID:     current.studentPracticeTask.WorkspaceLessonID,
		CurrentTaskAnswerID: current.studentPracticeTask.CurrentTaskAnswerID,
		CurrentSandboxID:    current.studentPracticeTask.ActiveSandboxID,
		PreviewURL:          current.studentPracticeTask.PreviewURL,
		Prerequisites:       prerequisites,
	}
}

func aggregatePartLessons(
	milestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone,
	completedLessons map[string]struct{},
) []domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartLesson {
	explicitLessons := make([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartLesson, 0)
	seenExplicit := make(map[string]struct{})
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		for _, binding := range sortedRuntimeLessonBindings(milestone.LessonBindings) {
			if _, ok := seenExplicit[binding.LessonID]; ok {
				continue
			}
			seenExplicit[binding.LessonID] = struct{}{}
			_, done := completedLessons[binding.LessonID]
			explicitLessons = append(explicitLessons, domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartLesson{
				LessonID:         binding.LessonID,
				CourseID:         binding.CourseID,
				Requirement:      binding.Requirement,
				SortOrder:        binding.SortOrder,
				StepTitle:        binding.StepTitle,
				StepInstructions: binding.StepInstructions,
				Completed:        done,
			})
		}
	}
	requiredSkillTagsByLessonID := map[string]map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		if len(milestone.LessonBindings) > 0 {
			continue
		}
		for _, lessonID := range milestone.Prerequisites.MatchedLessonIDs {
			if _, ok := requiredSkillTagsByLessonID[lessonID]; !ok {
				requiredSkillTagsByLessonID[lessonID] = map[string]struct{}{}
			}
			for _, skillTag := range milestone.Prerequisites.RequiredSkillTags {
				requiredSkillTagsByLessonID[lessonID][skillTag] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
	}
	lessonIDs := sortedStringKeysMap(requiredSkillTagsByLessonID)
	result := append([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartLesson(nil), explicitLessons...)
	for _, lessonID := range lessonIDs {
		if _, ok := seenExplicit[lessonID]; ok {
			continue
		}
		skillTags := sortedStringKeys(requiredSkillTagsByLessonID[lessonID])
		_, done := completedLessons[lessonID]
		result = append(result, domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartLesson{
			LessonID:          lessonID,
			Requirement:       domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired,
			RequiredSkillTags: skillTags,
			Completed:         done,
		})
	}
	return result
}

func derivePartStatus(milestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone) string {
	if len(milestones) == 0 {
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable
	}
	allCompleted := true
	hasFailed := false
	hasProgress := false
	hasAvailable := false
	hasLocked := false
	for _, item := range milestones {
		if item.Status != domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed && item.Status != domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusSkipped {
			allCompleted = false
		}
		switch item.Status {
		case domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusFailed:
			hasFailed = true
		case domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusInProgress:
			hasProgress = true
		case domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed:
			hasProgress = true
		case domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable:
			hasAvailable = true
		case domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked:
			hasLocked = true
		}
	}
	switch {
	case allCompleted:
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusPassed
	case hasFailed:
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusFailed
	case hasProgress:
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusInProgress
	case hasAvailable:
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable
	case hasLocked:
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked
	default:
		return domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusAvailable
	}
}

func flattenValidationIssues(result *domain.ValidationRunResult) []domain.ValidationRunIssue {
	if result == nil {
		return nil
	}
	issues := make([]domain.ValidationRunIssue, 0, len(result.Errors))
	issues = append(issues, result.Errors...)
	for _, stage := range result.Stages {
		issues = append(issues, stage.Errors...)
	}
	for _, link := range result.Links {
		issues = append(issues, link.Errors...)
	}
	return issues
}

func mergePartValidationResults(milestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartMilestone) domain.ValidationRunResult {
	result := domain.ValidationRunResult{
		ContractKind:    "validation_contract_v1",
		ContractVersion: 1,
		Stages:          []domain.ValidationStageRun{},
		Links:           []domain.ValidationLinkRun{},
		Errors:          []domain.ValidationRunIssue{},
	}
	allPassed := true
	for _, milestone := range milestones {
		if milestone.ValidationResult == nil {
			allPassed = false
			continue
		}
		if milestone.ValidationResult.ContractKind != "" {
			result.ContractKind = milestone.ValidationResult.ContractKind
		}
		if milestone.ValidationResult.ContractVersion > 0 {
			result.ContractVersion = milestone.ValidationResult.ContractVersion
		}
		result.Legacy = result.Legacy || milestone.ValidationResult.Legacy
		if !milestone.ValidationResult.Passed {
			allPassed = false
		}
		for _, stage := range milestone.ValidationResult.Stages {
			stageCopy := stage
			stageCopy.StageID = prefixedPartStageID(milestone.ID, stage.StageID)
			stageCopy.Errors = prefixValidationIssues(milestone.ID, stageCopy.Errors)
			stageCopy.Warnings = prefixValidationIssues(milestone.ID, stageCopy.Warnings)
			result.Stages = append(result.Stages, stageCopy)
		}
		for _, link := range milestone.ValidationResult.Links {
			linkCopy := link
			linkCopy.LinkID = prefixedPartStageID(milestone.ID, link.LinkID)
			linkCopy.Errors = prefixValidationIssues(milestone.ID, linkCopy.Errors)
			result.Links = append(result.Links, linkCopy)
		}
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, prefixValidationIssues(milestone.ID, milestone.ValidationResult.Errors)...)
	}
	result.Passed = allPassed && len(milestones) > 0
	return result
}

func prefixValidationIssues(milestoneID string, issues []domain.ValidationRunIssue) []domain.ValidationRunIssue {
	if len(issues) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]domain.ValidationRunIssue, 0, len(issues))
	for _, issue := range issues {
		issueCopy := issue
		if strings.TrimSpace(issueCopy.StageID) != "" {
			issueCopy.StageID = prefixedPartStageID(milestoneID, issueCopy.StageID)
		}
		result = append(result, issueCopy)
	}
	return result
}

func sortedStringKeysMap(values map[string]map[string]struct{}) []string {
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for key := range values {
		result = append(result, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result
}

func parentPartMilestoneID(item domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) string {
	if item.ParentPartMilestoneID == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(*item.ParentPartMilestoneID)
}

func previousSiblingMilestoneID(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, current domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) string {
	parentID := parentPartMilestoneID(current)
	siblings := make([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		if parentPartMilestoneID(item) != parentID {
			continue
		}
		siblings = append(siblings, item)
	}
	sort.Slice(siblings, func(left, right int) bool {
		if siblings[left].SortOrder == siblings[right].SortOrder {
			return siblings[left].Title < siblings[right].Title
		}
		return siblings[left].SortOrder < siblings[right].SortOrder
	})
	for index := range siblings {
		if siblings[index].ID != current.ID || index == 0 {
			continue
		}
		return siblings[index-1].ID
	}
	return ""
}

func previousRouteMilestoneID(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, current domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) string {
	ordered := domainservice.SortMilestonesForStudent(items)
	previousID := ""
	for _, item := range ordered {
		if !item.IsActive {
			continue
		}
		if item.ID == current.ID {
			return previousID
		}
		previousID = item.ID
	}
	return ""
}

func currentPartMilestone(current *partRuntimeContext) *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone {
	if current == nil {
		return nil
	}
	for _, milestone := range domainservice.SortMilestonesForStudent(current.partMilestones) {
		studentMilestone, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[milestone.ID]
		if !ok || isMilestoneCompleted(studentMilestone.Status) {
			continue
		}
		item := milestone
		return &item
	}
	return nil
}

func isMilestoneCompleted(status int16) bool {
	return status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed || status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped
}

func validationResultHasActivity(result domain.ValidationRunResult) bool {
	if len(result.Errors) > 0 || len(result.Stages) > 0 || len(result.Links) > 0 {
		return true
	}
	return result.Passed
}

func activePartID(project *domain.StudentPracticeTask) string {
	if project == nil {
		return ""
	}
	state := decodeWorkspaceState(project.WorkspaceStateJSON)
	if state.ActivePartID == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(*state.ActivePartID)
}

func decodeWorkspaceState(raw json.RawMessage) domain.StudentPracticeTaskWorkspaceState {
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return domain.StudentPracticeTaskWorkspaceState{}
	}
	var state domain.StudentPracticeTaskWorkspaceState
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &state); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPracticeTaskWorkspaceState{}
	}
	return state
}

func encodeWorkspaceState(state domain.StudentPracticeTaskWorkspaceState) json.RawMessage {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(state)
	if err != nil {
		return []byte(`{}`)
	}
	return payload
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) setActivePracticeTaskPart(ctx context.Context, project *domain.StudentPracticeTask, partID string) error {
	if project == nil {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	state := decodeWorkspaceState(project.WorkspaceStateJSON)
	trimmedPartID := strings.TrimSpace(partID)
	if trimmedPartID == "" {
		state.ActivePartID = nil
	} else {
		state.ActivePartID = &trimmedPartID
	}
	projectCopy := *project
	projectCopy.WorkspaceStateJSON = encodeWorkspaceState(state)
	projectCopy.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	if err := useCase.Students.UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, projectCopy); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	project.WorkspaceStateJSON = projectCopy.WorkspaceStateJSON
	project.UpdatedAt = projectCopy.UpdatedAt
	return nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) loadActivePartRuntimeContextForProject(
	ctx context.Context,
	project *domain.StudentPracticeTask,
	withBuild bool,
) (*partRuntimeContext, error) {
	partID := activePartID(project)
	if partID == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return useCase.loadPartRuntimeContext(ctx, project.StudentID, project.ID, partID, withBuild)
}

func firstLockedPartError(bundle domain.StudentPracticeTaskPartBundle) error {
	for _, milestone := range bundle.Milestones {
		if milestone.Status != domain.MilestoneRuntimeStatusLocked {
			continue
		}
		return &domain.MilestoneLockedError{
			StudentPracticeTaskID:          bundle.StudentPracticeTask.ID,
			StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID: milestone.StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID,
			BlockingReason:                 milestone.BlockingReason,
			Prerequisites:                  milestone.Prerequisites,
		}
	}
	return &domain.MilestoneLockedError{
		StudentPracticeTaskID: bundle.StudentPracticeTask.ID,
		BlockingReason:        bundle.Access.BlockingReason,
		Prerequisites:         bundle.Access.Prerequisites,
	}
}

func currentPartRepresentativeMilestone(current *partRuntimeContext) *domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone {
	if current == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if current.build != nil && len(current.build.Milestones) > 0 {
		milestoneID := current.build.Milestones[0].Milestone.ID
		if studentMilestone, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[milestoneID]; ok {
			item := studentMilestone
			return &item
		}
	}
	for _, milestone := range domainservice.SortMilestonesForStudent(current.partMilestones) {
		studentMilestone, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[milestone.ID]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if studentMilestone.Status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed || studentMilestone.Status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped {
			continue
		}
		item := studentMilestone
		return &item
	}
	for _, milestone := range domainservice.SortMilestonesForStudent(current.partMilestones) {
		studentMilestone, ok := current.studentMilestonesByPartMilestoneID[milestone.ID]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		item := studentMilestone
		return &item
	}
	return nil
}
